name: Votepit Self-Hosted Feature Voting
free_limit: Unlimited self-hosted feature-voting boards, ideas, up/down votes, comments and roadmap views under MIT-licensed software; no vendor-hosted resource quota is included.
watch_out: Requires your own PHP 8.2+ and MySQL/MariaDB hosting, plus SMTP for passwordless sign-in. No free managed hosting or email sending is included. Set up and maintain server security, backups and mail delivery yourself.
